command.permanentfood.milestone.attribut: Max %s is %s with a Milestone Bonus of %s.
permanentfood.foodsystem_config.sectionE: Whether or not exhaustion mechanics should be changed by this mod.
The starting maximum exhaustion before any milestones are reached.
Amount of exhaustion applied to the player when they heal one heart. Higher values increase exhaustion cost for healing. Vanilla default is 6.0.

The Amount of unique Foods eaten needed to reach the different Milestones. 
More Milestones will let you earn more max Exhaustion.
Must be in order from smallest to largest.

The Amount of max Exhaustion gained per Milestone reached. 
Higher values will make each Milestone more impactful.
permanentfood.foodsystem_config.sectionH: Whenever or not hunger mechanics should be changed from this mod.
The starting maximum hunger before any milestones are reached.

The Amount of unique Foods eaten needed to reach the different Milestones. 
More Milestones will let you earn more max hunger.
Must be in order from smallest to largest.

The Amount of max Hunger gained per Milestone reached. 
Higher values will make each Milestone more impactful.
permanentfood.foodsystem_config.sectionP: When true, players will still get hungry on Peaceful difficulty. Set to false to disable hunger on Peaceful.

Percentage of the hunger bar required for weak natural regeneration when the player has no saturation (vanilla: 90).
Requires the game rule 'naturalRegeneration' to be enabled. Values are rounded down.

Percentage of the hunger bar required for strong natural regeneration when the player has saturation (vanilla: 100).
Requires the game rule 'naturalRegeneration' to be enabled. Values are rounded down.
When hunger on Peaceful is enabled, this sets which difficulty's hunger rules to apply (EASY, NORMAL, or HARD).
permanentfood.foodsystem_config.sectionS: Whether or not saturation mechanics should be changed by this mod.
The starting maximum saturation before any milestones are reached.

The Amount of unique Foods eaten needed to reach the different Milestones. 
More Milestones will let you earn more max Saturation.
Must be in order from smallest to largest.

The Amount of max Saturation gained per Milestone reached. 
Higher values will make each Milestone more impactful.
